title: Reindeer Cardigan by the Window
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy light brown hair and thin round glasses sits on a window ledge, holding a small ginger kitten. She wears a brown and cream reindeer-pattern knit cardigan over a charcoal turtleneck, with a burgundy plaid skirt. Her expression is thoughtful. Soft, diffused window light. Palette of chocolate, cream, and burgundy. This is a duplicate of section 79.
workingNotes:
- The reindeer knit pattern and kitten are the focal points.
- Keep only one of sections 79 or 106 if you do not need both.
tryThis: Try this: Emphasize the reindeer knit pattern and kitten.
